overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Arlberg 3 Person Traditional Outdoor Sauna offers a luxurious retreat right in your backyard, designed to enhance relaxation and wellness. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock with a clear stain, this sauna combines traditional aesthetics with modern features like an 8.0 kW stove and an interior chromotherapy lighting system, including red light therapy for muscle relaxation and stress relief. Enjoy the convenience of built-in Bluetooth connectivity and performance speakers, making it easy to unwind with your favorite music. Ideal for outdoor settings, this sauna provides a serene escape with a temperature range of 170°F-185°F, perfect for rejuvenating both body and mind.

Golden Designs traditional saunas provide a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!
